property_summary: After Collect(uint256) is called, no caller's balance should decrease by more than the amount requested.
After Collect(uint256) is called, the caller's balance should never be less than the requested amount (i.e., no underflow)
The balances mapping should never decrease by an amount larger than the current balance of any address when Collect(uint256) reverts.
After Collect(uint256) is called, the sum of all balances in the contract should not increase by more than the amount of ETH sent to the contract (msg.value) in the same transaction.
After Collect(uint256) is called, the caller's balance does not decrease more than the previous balance minus _am (i.e., the subtraction does not underflow).
After Collect, the balance of msg.sender should not exceed the sum of its previous balance and the amount collected.
After Collect, the total contract balance should decrease by exactly the amount collected, while the caller's balance increases by the same amount.
After a successful Collect call, the balance of the caller must not increase.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's balance in the balances mapping must not exceed its previous balance.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's balance in the balances mapping must be less than or equal to its previous balance.
After any sequence of calls ending with Collect, the sum of all balances in the contract never exceeds the contract's Ether balance.
After any call to Collect, the balance of any address in the contract only decreases or stays the same.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's balance in the contract decreases by exactly the amount withdrawn.
The contract's total ether balance is always at least the sum of all recorded balances in the mapping.
After any Collect call, the caller's balance decreases by exactly the amount withdrawn or stays the same (no increase).
The balance of any address cannot decrease after a Collect call
After Collect, the caller's balance is equal to its prior balance minus the withdrawn amount, when the withdrawal amount does not cause overflow.
The balance of the caller after a successful Collect call equals the caller's balance before the Deposit that funded it minus the collected amount, specified over the sequence of calls.
After any sequence of calls ending with Collect(uint256), the sum of all recorded Deposit values in the LogFile equals the sum of all recorded Collect values plus the sender's final balance.
After a Collect call, the caller's balance cannot exceed the sum of its previous deposits minus the collected amount, as recorded in LogFile.
The value of MinSum before any call to Collect is equal to the value of MinSum after any call to Collect, if no SetMinSum call occurred after initialization.
After Collect is called, the value of MinSum is unchanged because SetMinSum is not called after initialization.
After initialization, the MinSum state variable remains unchanged regardless of any sequence of calls to Deposit or Collect.
After initialization, the MinSum state variable remains unchanged after any call to Collect(uint256).
For any call to Collect, the return value of MinSum after the call is equal to the value of MinSum before the call when called in an initialized contract.
After any Collect call, the MinSum value must remain unchanged.
After any Collect call, the value of MinSum must be exactly the same as before the call.
The MinSum variable remains unchanged after any call to Collect(uint256).
After any Collect call, the MinSum variable must remain unchanged even if the caller's balance check fails.
The value of MinSum must remain unchanged after any call to Collect, regardless of inputs.
After Collect, Log is updated if the caller had sufficient balance and the withdrawal amount is non-zero.
After Collect, the Log contract's history length is incremented if the call succeeded and the caller had sufficient balance.
After calling Collect, the LogFile contract's history length remains unchanged if the caller's balance was insufficient for the withdrawal.
After Collect, the log state variable (Log contract address) is unchanged from the last SetLogFile call.

After SetLogFile is called using SetLogFile(address), subsequent Collect calls revert if the LogFile contract address is not set; otherwise they succeed when the caller's balance and withdrawal conditions are met.
After a call to Collect, the balances of the caller are unchanged if the call reverts due to an insufficient balance or invalid log assignment.
After a Collect call with sufficient balance, the log history length increases by exactly 1.
After any call to Collect, the History length of the Log contract is exactly one more than before the call.
After a Collect call, the address stored in the Log public getter of contract C equals the address previously set by SetLogFile.
After a Collect call, the Log address stored in contract C remains unchanged from the address originally set by SetLogFile.
After calling Collect with any valid amount, the address stored in the LogFile does not change between calls.
After initialization, calling SetLogFile and then Collect, the function selector for LogFile remains zero (LogFile is never set).
After initialization, the value of MinSum remains equal to the value set by SetMinSum, regardless of calls to SetLogFile and Collect.
After calling Collect, the value of MinSum must remain unchanged from its initial set value.
After calling Collect, the value of MinSum remains unchanged from its initial value set by SetMinSum.
After Collect, the caller's balance in the contract should decrease by the collected amount.
After a successful Collect call, the total balance of the contract (address(this).balance) must decrease by exactly the collected amount.
After Collect, the logged total value in the LogFile for 'Collect' messages equals the amount transferred.
After Collect, the caller's balance in the contract must decrease by at least the withdrawal amount.
After a successful Collect call, the sum of the caller's balance in the contract and the amount collected must equal the caller's balance before the call.
After a Collect call, the caller's balance in the contract cannot be greater than the amount that was deposited (i.e., the sum of deposited amounts is non-negative).
After Collect, the sum of all balances is at least the sum of all deposits minus the sum of all Collect withdrawals.
After a Collect call, the balance of msg.sender in the contract decreases by exactly _am (i.e., old balance - new balance == _am).

After a Collect call, the contract's total balance (sum of all user balances via address(c).balance) must equal the sum of all deposits made minus the sum of all withdrawals, which holds in reference when the deposit adds msg.value but breaks when deposit subtracts it.
After a Collect call, a depositor's balance in the contract should not be negative.
When Collect(uint256 _am) is called with _am > 0, the actual amount sent to the caller equals _am.
The caller's balance after Collect call is reduced by exactly _am when the call succeeds.
After a successful call to Collect with _am > 0, the value of the Log's History array should contain a new entry whose Val field equals the _am that was passed.
After a Collect call that succeeds and does not revert, the balance of the caller (msg.sender) is increased by the amount _am that was requested (not zero).
After Collect(uint256 _am) with _am > 0 succeeds and does not revert, the caller's balance difference (new - old) equals _am (not 0).
After any call to Collect(uint256), the sum of all balances (including contract balance) remains invariant minus the collected amount.
After a call to Collect(uint256), the caller's balance is decreased by exactly _am, not by _am - 1.
After a successful Collect(uint256 _am) call, the actual ether transferred to the caller is exactly _am, not _am minus 1.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's balance in the contract's balances mapping is decreased by exactly _am.

After a successful Collect call, the total sum of all contract balances (including the contract's own Ether balance) equals the contract's initial total balance minus the sum of all amounts collected so far, where each collected amount is exactly the requested _am.
Collect should revert when caller's balance is less than MinSum, even if balance >= _am

After any sequence of deposits and calls to Collect, the contract's MinSum state variable is unchanged (remains the value set during initialization) and the Log contract's History length increases exactly when Collect succeeds.
After Collect(_am) returns, the caller's balance decreases by exactly _am only if the caller's initial balance was at least MinSum; otherwise the caller's balance does not decrease.

After any Collect(_am) call, the caller's balance decreases by exactly _am only if the caller's initial balance was at least MinSum the set in initialization; otherwise, the caller's balance does not decrease.
Collect must not succeed (i.e., caller's balance must not decrease and Log History must not increase) when caller's balance is below MinSum, but may succeed when balance >= MinSum.
